messages:
SRE Bot: incident created: routing-policy-misroute detected in production (cluster: us-west-2). auto-severity: P1. paging oncall
Amy Chen: seeing a spike in model-variant errors and a lot of near-instant failovers to variant_alpha -> variant_old. Graphs show increased 5xx and latency around 08:12 UTC.
Amy Chen: request rate steady, but tail latency doubled for a subset of customers.
Rahul Patel: oncall here, acknowledged. Paging team, can someone post initial mitigation steps?
Jess L: quick snapshot: traffic rerouted to variant_old because the policy resolver fell back to the deprecated field 'fallback_variant' after the schema migration earlier this morning.
Mike R: confirming — deploy at 07:45 rolled config-schema v2. The migration left 'fallback_variant' present in some policy bundles; resolver treats presence as authoritative and picks variant_old.
Amy Chen: logs: 
```
2026-03-15T08:11:52Z resolver INFO match policy_id=routes/checkout user=acct-1234 selected_variant=variant_old reason=deprecated_field_present(fallback_variant)
2026-03-15T08:12:03Z serving WARN model=variant_old token_error_rate=0.14 latency_p95=1.9s
```
Rahul Patel: immediate mitigation options: 1) hotfix resolver to ignore deprecated fallback_variant; 2) rollback config-schema v2; 3) push a policy patch to explicitly set fallback_policy. Which is safest?
Mike R: strongly prefer patching policies and canarying because rollback touches many infra changes. I can push a mass patch to policy-store to add explicit fallback_policy fields.
Jess L: I'll prepare the patch. It will set fallback_policy: {type: "explicit_variant", variant: "variant_beta"} for affected routes. Suggest canary to 5% before broad roll.
Deploy Bot: deploy triggered by Jess L: PATCH /policy-store/policies/bulk at 08:28 UTC (canary=5%). CI checks running.
Amy Chen: customer impact so far: 12 customers saw degraded quality and 3 customers reported failed requests (error spikes). Observability shows p50 ~ 220ms (normal), p95 1.9s (was 900ms).
Rahul Patel: thanks. Runbook step: route affected traffic to safe fallback (variant_beta) and disable auto-deprecated fallback behavior. Who will validate model outputs?
Mike R: I will validate outputs on the canary traffic and watch cost/latency. Amy can coordinate with CS about customer notices.
Jess L: canary patch applied. Patch payload: 
```
PATCH /policy-store/policies/bulk
[{
  "selector": "routes:checkout*",
  "changes": {"fallback_policy": {"type": "explicit_variant", "variant": "variant_beta"}}
}]
```
Deploy Bot: canary 5% success. No errors in policy-store write.
SRE Bot: alert volume down 70% after canary.
Amy Chen: initial validation from prod-checker: model responses for canary traffic look correct, latency back to p95 ~1.1s.
Rahul Patel: expanding canary to 25% now. Mike continue monitoring model-quality metrics.
Mike R: sanity checks passing for 25% run. No tokenization errors. Latency stable.
Jess L: rolling remaining 75% after 10m hold. Initiating now.
Deploy Bot: rollout complete at 08:42 UTC. All policies updated with explicit fallback_policy.
Amy Chen: post-roll status: 5xx back to baseline, p95 down to ~950ms, error alerts clearing.
Rahul Patel: Mitigation accepted. Root cause: schema migration to v2 changed default handling for deprecated field 'fallback_variant' -> resolver now prefers presence of deprecated keys when resolving policy. Policy bundles that still contained the deprecated key caused unintended variant selection.
Mike R: mitigation follow-ups: 1) add validator to config CI to reject bundles containing 'fallback_variant' without explicit 'fallback_policy'; 2) add resolver change to ignore deprecated fields for 48h until all bundles are cleaned; 3) backfill policies and run a sweep job.
Jess L: opening a ticket for the sweep job and CI validator. Linking to this thread.
Amy Chen: customer impact note for postmortem: affected ~0.6% of total requests for the hour, 12 customers had visible quality regressions, 3 customers had transient errors that auto-retried. No data exfiltration.
Rahul Patel: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by escalation policy, SRE and platform oncall paged. Handing off to postmortem owner.
Mike R: I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with product for communication. Expected ETA for postmortem draft: 48 hours.
Amy Chen: immediate action items (assigned): Mike R - postmortem owner; Jess L - sweep job + policy patch automation; Rahul Patel - add temporary resolver ignore flag and run monitoring; Amy Chen - CS customer outreach draft.
SRE Bot: incident auto-close check in 6h if no regressions.
Amy Chen: marking incident monitored. If anything else shows up, ping here. :thumbsup:
